trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback completed:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (18% error rate, unhealthy).
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release healthy in production and rolled back all regions to it.
- First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error) — us-east rolled back but us-west/eu-west stayed on v2.3.1. A retry completed the rollout.
- Verified final state: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on **v2.3.0**, healthy, error rate down to **0.2%**.

**Incident opened:**
- **INC-0002** (SEV2, checkout-api, on-call paged) documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), and the resulting healthy state.

transcript.content: I'll start by checking the deployment history and current status of checkout-api.
transcript.reasoning_content: Need to check deployments first, then rollback, then incident. Get deployment history (and maybe status) in parallel.

transcript.content: Current state confirmed: checkout-api is running v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate) in all three regions. The most recent release that was healthy in production is **v2.3.0**. Rolling back now.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback to v2.3.0 (most recent healthy). Note: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy. Rollback doesn't require approval (only deploying never-healthy versions does). Do rollback first, then incident.

transcript.content: The rollback halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error. Let me check the current state to see what actually rolled back.
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback partially failed — us-east may have rolled back, then orchestrator error halted. Check status.

transcript.content: us-east is now on v2.3.0, but us-west and eu-west are still on the unhealthy v2.3.1. I'll retry the rollback to converge the remaining regions.
transcript.reasoning_content: us-east rolled back to v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1. Retry the rollback to converge remaining regions.

transcript.content: All regions are now on v2.3.0. Verifying health, then opening the incident.
